This is a private landlord's utility-cost statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung), not an administrative decision, so it carries no legal Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and the standard Einspruch/Widerspruch/Klage framework does not apply; objections to the accuracy of the statement would instead follow civil/tenancy law and contractual deadlines (e.g. §556(3) BGB objection periods), which are not stated in this letter.
